pr893.head: 807bbc4ce64b80d34b3102c774daf35e454d04be
findings: current_sources and file_digests function text remain identical to 8b9; no runtime HIA whole-source scanner/admission owner in this examined path.
SOURCE_BUILD_FILES and COMPILER_BUILD_FILES are packaged, inventoried and freshly checked by hosted installed custody; they do not cache or replace the checkout scan.
HIA source-bundle build/pack owns supplied-bundle compilation and self-repacking. Its hosted bootstrap still calls admit_cold_build/current_sources; its native runtime opens no source-tree files.
Publisher adds actual F_GET_SEALS and descriptor extent/byte readback. This is useful separate custody work, not a measured source-scan optimization.
Sources use .hepta suffixes, while this candidate uses .hiaasm. Resource lists/manifests must be integrated by actual union and rebinding.
Its publisher lacks NativePublicationRefusal, which 8b9's namespace uses for confirmed returned read-only refusal provenance. Do not overwrite the current publisher wholesale.

pr894.head: 5386be50a1faddc0d986af3c04cad37a4ac6c102
pr894.scope: Publisher inspected only; no independent full PR validation.
findings: Checkout still invokes current_sources; no NativePublicationRefusal class in the inspected publisher.
Sealed executable readback differs from PR893; do not transfer one branch's result to the other.

native_owner_assessment.proposed_scope: Complete explicitly selected checkout source-admission state owner, not a file-hash facade and not a claim to replace installed package custody.
owners_required: Own the current semantic support declaration as native data and all declared-contract comparison decisions; no callback to hosted support_contract or validate_contract on the selected path.
Own fresh dynamic path union, exact ordering, per-file pending/read/closed/hash/receipt states, and complete source-map equality before returning admission.
Own SHA-256 state and digest rendering; reuse the existing HIA SHA algebra only after retaining its actual capacity and failure boundaries.
Bind returned admission to this call's exact source observation, policy image and selected executable-manifest identity; no implicit cross-call reuse or fallback.
allowed_fixed_foreign_boundary: Exact original Path conversion/root selection, directory enumeration and ordered read/close primitives with original OS errors.
Existing JSON/object transport with preserved original parsing, type/number equality and error order; it cannot decide final admission.
Explicit image and raw source/manifest custody, allocation and syscall transport; no hidden policy callback.
Authoring-time conversion of the retained semantic support declaration to native constants is separate from selected runtime policy.

actual_reuse_candidates.role: Native incremental SHA init/update/final; fixed 1184-byte state, 8MiB per chunk and MAX_TOTAL=(1<<61)-1.
Native schedule and 64-round compression algebra, byte serialization.
Fixed syscall transport pattern and native SHA calls; its publication path and receipt policy are distinct and must not be reused as a generic source verifier.

blockers_before_any_default_or_performan: Existing native stream MAX_TOTAL is narrower than an unqualified claim over arbitrary original read_bytes inputs; chunking avoids its chunk limit but does not erase the total limit.
The current scalar HIA SHA implementation has no demonstrated full-closure throughput benefit. Native language ownership alone does not establish a 3-second fix.
Runtime admission needs a self-bound policy/manifest selection boundary without recursively calling the source admission being replaced.
Full original JSON numeric equality, source-path ordering, unknown outcome custody and original exception precedence require independent actual-machine controls.
Installed resources and PR893 builder roles require separate explicit composition; checkout-only completion cannot be reported as installed/full closure.
native_owner_assessment.action: Design assessment only. No new native source-admission product implementation or performance success claimed.
